description: This file defines a data class 'Report' with serialization attributes and an interface 'ILoadGrain' with method signatures for generating workload and retrieving reports, used in Orleans grains for testing load.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: A serializable data class to record success, failure, and elapsed time metrics.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates a workload generation with specific run and concurrency parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current load test report.
